records.text: Owens recalled an unnamed Daily Wire co-CEO demanding that she condemn Kanye West and asking whether she understood how difficult her refusal was for Ben Shapiro.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #1 (Ep FGoeoZxDN1c)

appearances.snippet: And so many people who were in his life made that statement, and I didn't. And so the consequence that I faced at the Daily Wire, after a very heated conference—literally the co-CEO banged his fist and was like, why won't you do this for us? Don't you realize how hard this is for Ben (Ben Shapiro) that you won't make a statement? Like, I look back, and could you imagine if I had sold Kanye (Kanye West) out for Ben Shapiro? It's funny to reflect on, but I held the line.
